newsitem.title: USA: Bridge outage may hurt Lady Luck results.
newsitem.headline: Bridge outage may hurt Lady Luck results.

text.p: Lady Luck Gaming Corp Thursday said operations at its Rhythm & Blues and Country Casinos in Mississippi will be adversely affected by the closure of a bridge that connects the casino to Helena, Ark.
In a statement, the company said the Helena Bridge, which crosses the Mississippi River, has been closed indefinitely by the Arkansas Department of Transportation.
The bridge was said to have suffered structural damage in an overnight accident involving a barge traveling on the river.

The company said Arkansas officials have announced the bridge will be closed indefinitely, pending assessment of the damage. Company officials say they are closely monitoring the situation, and are pursuing other methods of providing access to the two casinos to customers in Arkansas.

Lady Luck officials say that for the period of time the bridge is closed, access to the casino will be adversely impacted and, as a result, there may be a material adverse impact on the casino's operations and on the company.
